'

to_epoch() {
	date -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null && return 0
	date -u '
  +  b'-j -f "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S" "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null
}

# busybox date wants ''
  +  b"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; GNU date takes the T and Z too. Normalize.
exp_epo"
  +  b'ch=$(to_epoch "$(printf '%s' "$expires" | sed 's/T/ /; s/Z$//')") ||'
  +  b'
	blind "SANDBOX_EXPIRES_AT '$expires' does not parse as a date"
now'
  +  b'=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
now_epoch=$(date -u +%s)

if [ "$now_epo'
  +  b'ch" -lt "$exp_epoch" ]; then
	echo "ok      sandbox-sweep  launched, exp'
  +  b'ires $expires; not yet"
	exit 0
fi

token=$(sed -e 's/[[:space:]]*$/'
  +  b'/' "$token_file" | tr -d '\n')
remote=${SANDBOX_SWEEPER_REMOTE:-http'
  +  b's://github.com/$repo.git}

out=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$out"' EXI'
  +  b'T
